title: THE SOCIAL IMPACT OF GENERATIVE AI: AN ANALYSIS ON CHATGPT

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative coding and frequency analysis (using Atlas.ti) within a systematic literature review to track mentions and concerns of sexist views and stereotypes reported in ChatGPT.
Qualitative coding and frequency analysis within a systematic literature review to identify recurring concerns regarding racist views stemming from the characteristics of ChatGPT's training data.
Qualitative analysis of literature and media documents to identify the presence of political bias as a recognized emerging trend and concern in the generative AI market.
